summary: Contract-freeze-class repair of Finding F-1 (Phase 137L, NOT VERIFIED verdict). Amended TAMPC-001's frozen inspect_artifact_at_path signature (TAMPC-REQ-023) from the unimplementable two-parameter form (path, json_output) to the three-parameter form (path, artifact_bytes, json_output=False) the shipped, tested Phase 137K implementation already uses -- Finding F-1's recommended option (a). Added TAMPC-REQ-179 through TAMPC-REQ-182 (new Section 5.1) making CLI-layer/orchestration artifact-read ownership explicit and normative, resolving the contradiction between the old frozen signature and TAMPC-REQ-038/042's single-read/TOCTOU requirement. Reworded TAMPC-REQ-021, TAMPC-REQ-022, TAMPC-REQ-023 (ownership cross-references and corrected signature); added one editorial cross-reference sentence to TAMPC-REQ-042 (no normative change). No other of the 178 original requirements was modified; requirement count grew from 178 to 182, matching exactly the four additions -- independently confirmed via grep -o '^TAMPC-REQ-[0-9]*' | sort -u | wc -l against both the pre-repair (git show HEAD) and post-repair contract text. Compatibility Review Outcome A: the shipped Phase 137K implementation already conforms to the repaired contract -- no production code, test, or CLI-surface change was made, confirmed by reading src/pcae/cltr/authority_inspection.py:311-332 and src/pcae/commands/authority_inspect.py:49-140 and by grepping both modules and their tests for any second file-read call. TAMPC-001 version bumped 1.0 to 1.1 (new Section 36 revision record identifying predecessor, reason, changed requirements, migration effect, affected consumer classes, and backward-compatibility impact per TAMC-REQ-067's process applied to TAMPC-001 itself, per TAMPC-REQ-155; new Section 37 next-phase pointer). See docs/PHASE_137M_TAMPC_SIGNATURE_AMBIGUITY_CONTRACT_REPAIR.md.
